ADC_RULE_ACTIONS

Table to store activities per rule.

Columns
cra_id

PK

cra_crg_id

Unique, references ADC_RULE

cra_cru_id

Unique, references ADC_RULE

cra_cpi_id

Unique, references ADC_PAGE_ITEM

cra_cat_id

Unique, references ADC_ACTION_TYPE

cra_on_error

Flag to indicate whether the rule action shall be executed only in case of a PL/SQL error

cra_param_1

Optional first parameter, passed to ACTION_TYPE

cra_param_2

Optional second parameter, passed to ACTION_TYPE

cra_param_3

Optional third parameter, passed to ACTION_TYPE

cra_comment

Optional comment to describe the action

cra_raise_recursive

Flag to indicate whether the rule action triggers recursive rule execution

cra_raise_on_validation

Flag to indicate whether this action is executed when validating a page

cra_sort_seq

Sorting criteria to control execution flow

cra_active

Flag to indicate whether RULE_ACTION is in use

cra_has_error

Flag to indicate whether RULE_ACTION has an error

References
cra_cat_id

references ADC_ACTION_TYPES (cat_id)

cra_crg_id, cra_cpi_id

references ADC_PAGE_ITEMS (cpi_crg_id, cpi_id)

cra_cru_id

references ADC_RULES (cru_id)
